status_note: Recommendations only. Nothing here is approved. "Canonical candidate" means proposed for owner confirmation.

authority_levels.A1-governing: Agent and workflow rules (CLAUDE.md wins; CONTEXT.md and PM-WORKFLOW.md are subordinate detail or pointers).
authority_levels.A2-register: Decision register: rulings and their supersession (DECISIONS.md).
authority_levels.A3-spec: One canonical spec per subsystem; detail beneath the register.
authority_levels.A4-plan: Active plans and their status home; subordinate to specs and register.
authority_levels.A4-status: Snapshots of state and work status; never decide design.
authority_levels.A5-reference: Non-binding reference, baselines, illustrations, external material.
authority_levels.A6-historical: Archives and applied records; never compete with current rules.
authority_levels.A0-none: Outside the documentation authority model (legal, tooling, temporary).
authority_levels.unresolved: Authority cannot be established without the owner.
